issues.display_title: Issue #40: Sync GoThru Account Deletion with Directory Profile
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 21/07/26

✅ Implementation: Account Deletion Webhook Implementation

Summary

Implemented an authenticated webhook that lets the main GoThru account-deletion flow remove the matching 360 Photographers directory profile and all related directory data.

Endpoint

POST /v1/photographers/webhooks/account-deleted

Request

POST /v1/photographers/webhooks/account-deleted
X-Webhook-Secret: <ACCOUNT_DELETION_WEBHOOK_SECRET>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "gothruUserId": 12345
}

Also supports legacy/body alias:

{
  "user_id": 12345
}

Files Changed

  • src/action/v1/photographers/deletePhotographerProfile.go
  • src/action/v1/photographers/deletePhotographerProfile_test.go
  • src/controllers/v1/photographers/accountDeletionWebhook.go
  • src/controllers/v1/photographers/accountDeletionWebhook_test.go
  • src/routes/v1/photographersRoutes.go
  • src/config/environment.go
  • .env.example
  • README.md
  • go.mod
  • go.sum

Implementation Details

Action

Created:

func DeletePhotographerProfileByGothruUserID(gothruUserId uint64) (*DeletePhotographerProfileResult, error)

Behavior:

  • Looks up the directory profile by photographers.gothru_user_id.
  • If no profile exists, returns success with Deleted: false.
  • If profile exists, deletes profile data inside a DB transaction.
  • Clears related Redis cache patterns after a successful delete.

Deleted tables:

  • reviews_reply
  • reviews
  • photographer_sublocations
  • portfolio
  • photographers_equipment
  • photographers_services
  • photographer_availabilities
  • photographers_slugs
  • photographers

Delete logic:

err = db.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
	deletes := []struct {
		query string
		args  []interface{}
		model interface{}
	}{
		{"photographer_id = ?", []interface{}{photographer.ID}, &models.DirectoryReviewReply{}},
		{"photographer_id = ?", []interface{}{photographer.ID}, &models.DirectoryReview{}},
		{"photographer_id = ?", []interface{}{photographer.ID}, &models.DirectoryPhotographerSublocation{}},
		{"photographer_id = ?", []interface{}{photographer.ID}, &models.DirectoryPortfolio{}},
		{"photographer_id = ?", []interface{}{photographer.ID}, &models.DirectoryPhotographerEquipment{}},
		{"photographers_id = ?", []interface{}{photographer.ID}, &models.DirectoryPhotographerService{}},
		{"photographer_id = ?", []interface{}{photographer.ID}, &models.DirectoryPhotographerAvailability{}},
		{"photographers_id = ?", []interface{}{photographer.ID}, &models.DirectoryPhotographerSlug{}},
	}

	for _, item := range deletes {
		if err := tx.Where(item.query, item.args...).Delete(item.model).Error; err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}

	return tx.Delete(&photographer).Error
})

Controller

Added:

func AccountDeletionWebhook(c *fiber.Ctx) error

Behavior:

  • Requires ACCOUNT_DELETION_WEBHOOK_SECRET to be configured.
  • Rejects requests if secret is unset.
  • Validates X-Webhook-Secret using constant-time comparison.
  • Parses gothruUserId from JSON body.
  • Calls delete action.
  • Logs internal errors server-side.
  • Returns generic error message to client on failure.

Auth check:

if config.Env.AccountDeletionWebhookSecret == "" {
	return helpers.FormatResponse(c, 503, fiber.Map{"error": "Webhook secret is not configured"}, startTime)
}

if subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(c.Get("X-Webhook-Secret")), []byte(config.Env.AccountDeletionWebhookSecret)) != 1 {
	return helpers.FormatResponse(c, 401, fiber.Map{"error": "Invalid webhook secret"}, startTime)
}

Route

Added to photographer routes:

group.Post("/webhooks/account-deleted", photographersController.AccountDeletionWebhook)

Final route:

POST /v1/photographers/webhooks/account-deleted

Environment

Added:

ACCOUNT_DELETION_WEBHOOK_SECRET=

Added to config:

AccountDeletionWebhookSecret string

Loaded with:

Env.AccountDeletionWebhookSecret = getEnvStr("ACCOUNT_DELETION_WEBHOOK_SECRET", "")

Response Shape

Deleted profile:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "message": "Directory profile deleted",
    "result": {
      "gothruUserId": 12345,
      "photographerId": 77,
      "slug": "photographer-slug",
      "deleted": true
    }
  }
}

Already deleted or never existed:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "message": "Directory profile already deleted",
    "result": {
      "gothruUserId": 12345,
      "deleted": false
    }
  }
}

Missing webhook secret config:

{
  "statusCode": 503,
  "data": {
    "error": "Webhook secret is not configured"
  }
}

Invalid webhook secret:

{
  "statusCode": 401,
  "data": {
    "error": "Invalid webhook secret"
  }
}

Notes

  • Endpoint is destructive, so it fails closed when ACCOUNT_DELETION_WEBHOOK_SECRET is empty.
  • Secret validation uses crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare.
  • DB errors are logged server-side and not returned raw to clients.
  • Delete is idempotent for repeated webhook delivery.
  • Redis cache invalidation covers detail, list, dashboard, count, markers, geodata, portfolio, equipment, review, services, and location patterns.

Verification

Ran:

go test ./src/controllers/v1/photographers -run TestAccountDeletionWebhook
go test ./src/action/v1/photographers -run TestDeletePhotographerProfileByGothruUserID
go test ./...

Result: pass.

Description

Administrative workflow & data-management enhancement for 360photographers.org, for data compliance and to keep the admin dashboard clean.

Account Deletion Sync: Currently, if a user deletes their main GoThru account, their profile remains orphaned in the 360 Photographers Directory. Implement a cascading deletion / synchronization mechanism so that deleting a GoThru account automatically removes the user's profile (and associated data) from the directory.

Acceptance Criteria

  1. When a user deletes their GoThru account, their profile and associated data are automatically and completely removed from 360photographers.org.

Technical notes (grounded in this repo)

  • Cross-database join, no FK cascade possible. The GoThru account lives in users (ConnGothruMod); the directory profile lives in photographers (ConnPhotographers) — a different database — joined by photographers.gothru_user_id = users.user_id. A DB-level ON DELETE CASCADE can't span the two connections, so this needs an application-level sync:
    • Option A — event/webhook: the GoThru account-deletion flow notifies this service (or publishes to RabbitMQ) → a consumer deletes the directory profile.
    • Option B — endpoint: expose an internal DELETE /v1/photographers/:gothruUserId that the GoThru side calls on account deletion.
    • Option C — reconciliation job: periodic sweep removing directory profiles whose gothru_user_id no longer exists in users.
  • "Associated data" to remove (all keyed by the photographer row, ConnPhotographers): photographers, photographer_sublocations, portfolios, equipment, service links, availability links, reviews, and slug history. Wrap in a transaction.
  • Cache + search invalidation: clear detail / list / dashboard / markers / geodata / count Redis patterns and any Martin/tile or search-index entries so the removed profile disappears from the map and directory immediately.
  • No whole-profile delete endpoint exists today (only sub-resource deletes: equipment/portfolio/services/availability), so this is net-new.

Extended acceptance criteria (proposed)

  • Deleting a GoThru account removes the directory profile and all associated rows (sublocations, portfolio, equipment, services, availabilities, reviews, slug history).
  • Sync mechanism agreed (event/webhook vs endpoint vs reconciliation) and documented, since it spans two databases.
  • Relevant Redis caches + map/search entries invalidated so the profile no longer appears.
  • Idempotent + safe if the profile was already removed / never existed.

Note — second enhancement not captured here. The source feedback mentions two items: this account-deletion sync and "I need to be able to delete requests, since I do not want to be stuck with rejected requests forever." That request-deletion capability is a separate piece of work and is not covered by this issue. Recommend a separate task for it — say the word and I'll create it.

issues.display_title: Issue #42: Add is_deleted flag and request_date to photographers for support dashboard
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 21/07/26

✅ Implementation: Support Dashboard Delete Flag

Summary

Implemented support-dashboard hiding for photographer profiles using is_deleted, plus request_date tracking for update requests.

Issue:

Add is_deleted flag and request_date to photographers for support dashboard

Database Change

Already applied manually:

ALTER TABLE photographers
  ADD COLUMN is_deleted TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN request_date DATETIME NULL;

Behavior

  • is_deleted = true hides a photographer from GET /v1/photographers/users/dashboard.
  • Public directory endpoints are not changed by this issue.
  • request_date is set when support notification is sent through POST /v1/photographers/:gothruUserId/notify-update.
  • Sending notify-update also resets is_deleted = false, so a hidden photographer reappears in the support dashboard.
  • notify-update test mode only sends a test email to the photographer. It does not update request_date or reset is_deleted.
  • Dashboard ordering is now pending first, then newest request date first.

Files Changed

  • src/models/directory_photographer.go
  • src/action/v1/photographers/getPhotographersDashboard.go
  • src/action/v1/photographers/notifyPhotographerUpdate.go
  • src/action/v1/photographers/deleteFlag.go
  • src/controllers/v1/photographers/updatePhotographerDeleteFlag.go
  • src/routes/v1/photographersRoutes.go

Tests Added

  • src/action/v1/photographers/dashboard_delete_flag_test.go
  • src/action/v1/photographers/deleteFlag_test.go
  • src/action/v1/photographers/notify_request_date_test.go
  • src/controllers/v1/photographers/updatePhotographerDeleteFlag_test.go

Implementation Details

Model

Added fields to DirectoryPhotographer:

IsDeleted   bool       `gorm:"column:is_deleted;not null;default:0" json:"is_deleted"`
RequestDate *time.Time `gorm:"column:request_date" json:"request_date"`

Dashboard Query

Dashboard now excludes deleted rows:

query := db.Model(&models.DirectoryPhotographer{}).Where("is_deleted = ?", false)

Dashboard ordering:

CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(request_date, created_at) DESC

Dashboard cache key version changed from 1 to 2.

Notify Update

After email is sent successfully, the photographer row is updated:

if !req.TestMode {
	if err := markPhotographerUpdateRequested(gothruUserId); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
}

markPhotographerUpdateRequested sets:

Updates(map[string]interface{}{
	"request_date": time.Now(),
	"is_deleted":   false,
})

Then dashboard cache is cleared. In test mode, this DB mutation is skipped so test delivery cannot resurrect a hidden photographer or move them to the top of the dashboard.

Delete Flag Endpoint

Added:

PATCH /v1/photographers/:gothruUserId/delete-flag
Content-Type: application/json

Request:

{
  "isDeleted": true
}

isDeleted is required. An empty body or {} returns 400 instead of defaulting to false.

Response:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "gothruUserId": 12345,
    "isDeleted": true
  }
}

When photographer does not exist, response is 404.

Verification

Ran:

go test ./src/action/v1/photographers -run "TestNotifyPhotographerUpdate(TestModeDoesNotMutateRequestDateOrVisibility|SetsRequestDateAndRestoresDashboardVisibility)|TestGetPhotographersDashboardExcludesDeletedAndUsesRequestDate|TestUpdatePhotographerDeleteFlagUpdatesByGothruUserID" -count=1
go test ./src/controllers/v1/photographers -run "TestUpdatePhotographerDeleteFlag(ReturnsUpdatedFlag|RejectsMissingIsDeleted)" -count=1
go test ./...

Result: pass.

Non-Code Notes

  • Database columns were already added manually.
  • Backend must be deployed or restarted before the new model fields and endpoint are active.
  • Frontend/support tooling can call PATCH /v1/photographers/:gothruUserId/delete-flag to hide or restore a known photographer profile.

Summary

Add two new columns to the photographers table:

  • is_deleted — support-only flag to hide a photographer from the support dashboard list (GET /v1/photographers/users/dashboard). Public endpoints are NOT affected.
  • request_date — set whenever the photographer notifies support of a profile update (NotifyPhotographerUpdate).

Key behavior: notifying support is also the "resurrect" path — it sets request_date = NOW() and resets is_deleted = false, so a hidden photographer reappears at the top of the dashboard list.

Changes

1. DDL (manual — no AutoMigrate in this project)

ALTER TABLE photographers
  ADD COLUMN is_deleted TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN request_date DATETIME NULL;

2. Model — src/models/directory_photographer.go

Add IsDeleted bool (column:is_deleted;not null;default:0) and RequestDate *time.Time (column:request_date).

3. Dashboard — src/action/v1/photographers/getPhotographersDashboard.go

  • Add WHERE is_deleted = false to the query (all filter paths).
  • Change ordering to: CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(request_date, created_at) DESC — pending first, then most recent update request on top.
  • Response requestDate: use request_date, fall back to created_at when null.
  • Bump cache key Version: 1 → 2 (in RedisKeyParams) to instantly invalidate stale cached entries.

4. Notify — src/action/v1/photographers/notifyPhotographerUpdate.go

After the notification email is sent successfully:

UPDATE photographers SET request_date = NOW(), is_deleted = false WHERE gothru_user_id = ?

Then clear the dashboard cache pattern (helpers.RedisKey.PhotographerDashboardPattern()).

5. New endpoint — toggle delete flag

Mirror the existing PATCH /:gothruUserId/status pattern (route → controller → action):

  • PATCH /v1/photographers/:gothruUserId/delete-flag
  • Body: {"isDeleted": true|false}
  • Updates the column, clears the dashboard cache pattern.
  • Response: {"gothruUserId": ..., "isDeleted": ...}; 404 when photographer not found.

6. Tests

  • Dashboard query excludes is_deleted = true rows.
  • Notify update sets request_date and resets is_deleted.

Out of scope

  • isDeleted field in the dashboard response (the list never contains deleted rows).
  • A "list deleted photographers" endpoint — hidden photographers only reappear via the notify-update flow (or a direct toggle call with a known gothruUserId).
  • Index on is_deleted — add later only if the dashboard query gets slow.
